highlights: Safeguarding reports and safeguarding procedures integrated into data and school policy
Medical health support and visits to doctor managed via personal accounts
safety.policy_summary: Regent's International School Bangkok is committed to safeguarding personal data and student wellbeing in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) and internal safeguarding protocols. The school processes health information, emergency contacts, and safeguarding reports under strict access controls, encryption, and retention limits to maintain a secure and protective environment for all students.
